'''February 2002 Orlando tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Orlando, Florida on 23 February 2002. It is known from Sean Weigold's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3396">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-24-orlando-florida-2-23-02d3396/ orlando-florida-2-23-02], DeckTech (Sean "einnobevoli" Weigold, 24 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-24-orlando-florida-2-23-02d3396/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 February 2002
* '''Site:''' Orlando, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections Booster Draft]]
